Inside the publications

57 chapter, essay and supporting-text descriptions across 4 published editions. Enter a book through its contents, follow an individual text, and open its first page in the reading room.

Reading the references

Titles are transcribed from full headings in the deposited PDFs and checked against their contents lists. A part reference identifies a local description within a parent publication. The edition DOI, authorship and rights remain attached to that publication.

PDF file pages count from the first file page. Printed page labels retain the book’s own pagination, including roman numerals for front matter. They can differ from the reading room page counter.
